name: Action Link Entity Links
description: Outputs an action link's links automatically in the node or comment entity links area (the Read more / Edit row).
project_description: Submodule of Action Link. Provides an 'Entity links' Action Link Output plugin that inserts an action link's links into the entity links section of nodes and comments (via hook_node_links_alter() / hook_comment_links_alter()). Applies only to action links whose state action targets an entity with a single 'entity' dynamic parameter, on the node or comment entity types. Each link is rendered through a lazy builder so the action links' low cacheability does not degrade the caching of the rest of the entity links.
